# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin — Rbac Groups

> 9 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin under Rbac Groups. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Rbac Groups

- [Add RBAC Group Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/rbac_groups/members/create.md): Add a User to an RBAC Group. Membership of groups provisioned by an identity provider (source type `"scim"`) cannot be modified via the API.
- [Create RBAC Group](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/rbac_groups/create.md): Name of the RBAC Group. Not uniqueness-enforced.
- [Delete RBAC Group](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/rbac_groups/delete.md): Delete an RBAC Group. Groups provisioned by an identity provider (source type `"scim"`) cannot be deleted via the API.
- [Get RBAC Group](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/rbac_groups/retrieve.md): Retrieve an RBAC Group by ID.
- [List RBAC Group Members](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/rbac_groups/members/list.md): Optionally set to the `next_page` token from the previous response.
- [List RBAC Groups](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/rbac_groups/list.md): Optionally set to the `next_page` token from the previous response.
- [Members](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/rbac_groups/members.md): Optionally set to the `next_page` token from the previous response.
- [Remove RBAC Group Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/rbac_groups/members/delete.md): Remove a User from an RBAC Group. Membership of groups provisioned by an identity provider (source type `"scim"`) cannot be modified via the API.
- [Update RBAC Group](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/rbac_groups/update.md): Name of the RBAC Group. Not uniqueness-enforced.
